PersonaMem-v2: Towards Personalized Intelligence via Learning Implicit User Personas and Agentic Memory

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Personalization dataset/benchmark simulating 1,000 user-chatbot interactions with 20,000+ mostly implicit preferences in up to 128k-token contexts; RFT and agentic-memory training are additional contributions. RFT trains reasoning, not storing a user's facts in weights, so not parametric.
